config.dbExplorer.query.maxRows: Maximum rows fetched per query/table page
config.dbExplorer.connection.connectTime: Connection timeout (milliseconds, including SSH tunnel establishment)
config.dbExplorer.queries.directory: Directory for saved query files (tree "Queries" folder and Save Query; leave empty to use the extension global storage, not bound to the workspace; supports ~/ prefix, e.g. ~/Documents/db-queries)
config.dbExplorer.transaction.idleTimeou: Interactive transaction idle timeout (milliseconds; automatic ROLLBACK on expiry, D-09/§4.6, default 5 minutes)
config.dbExplorer.edit.allowNoPrimaryKey: Enable "full-column matching" edit mode for tables without a primary key (WHERE includes original values of all columns; tables containing binary columns remain non-editable, D-03)
config.dbExplorer.ai.endpoint: AI service endpoint (OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1; configure the API key in the AI settings page, stored only in the system secret store)
